experiments.name: service-b-latency
experiments.hypothesis: A controlled +200 ms delay in service-b increases the observed end-to-end p99 beyond the 500 ms SLO while service health remains available.
experiments.blast_radius: One local Compose service-b container and requests sent by this runner; no AWS resources.
stop_conditions: timebox exceeded for baseline, injection, or recovery
observed injection error rate exceeds 80% after at least 20 requests

experiments.name: data-service-errors
experiments.hypothesis: A reversible 10% controlled error rate in data-service increases observed failures while the service health endpoint remains available.
experiments.blast_radius: One local Compose data-service container and requests sent by this runner; no AWS resources.
stop_conditions: timebox exceeded for baseline, injection, or recovery
observed injection error rate exceeds 80% after at least 20 requests
